meta_description: Manchester Electrical Solutions offers expert electrical services across Manchester. NICEIC registered, free quotes, rapid response. Call us today for a reliable local electrician.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Registered Electricians — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Electrical faults don't wait — get a qualified Manchester electrician to your door fast, with no hidden charges.
services_subhead: From fault-finding and rewires to EV charger installation and consumer unit upgrades, we handle every electrical need safely and efficiently.

services.title: Full & Partial Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring is a leading cause of house fires. Our qualified electricians carry out full and partial rewires to bring your property up to current BS 7671 standards, keeping your family safe.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade your fuse board to a modern, RCD-protected consumer unit that meets current regulations. We supply and fit leading-brand units with a full completion certificate.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping circuits, flickering lights, or dead sockets? We use specialist diagnostic equipment to locate faults quickly, minimising disruption and getting your power restored fast.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: We install OZEV-approved home EV charging points to suit all electric and hybrid vehicles. Fast, tidy installation by a certified installer — ready to use the same day.

services.title: Electrical Inspections & EICR
services.desc: Whether you're a landlord, homeowner, or business, our Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICRs) give you a clear picture of your installation's safety and legal compliance.

services.title: Lighting Design & Installation
services.desc: From LED downlighter retrofits to full feature-lighting schemes, we design and install solutions that transform your space and cut energy bills at the same time.

about_pullquote: We do the job right first time, every time — no shortcuts, ever.
about_para_1: Manchester Electrical Solutions was founded by a team of experienced, fully qualified electricians based in the heart of Manchester's Northern Quarter. Operating from our Swan Street base in M4, we've built the business by delivering safe, reliable electrical work to homeowners, landlords, and businesses right across the city and surrounding areas.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is straightforward: we turn up when we say we will, we explain everything in plain English, and we never leave a job until you're completely satisfied. Our customers come back to us time and again because they know every installation is backed by the relevant certification and a genuine commitment to quality workmanship.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Came out the same day to sort a tripping consumer unit, explained everything clearly, and left the place spotless. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had a full rewire done on a terraced house in Salford. The lads were professional, tidy, and finished bang on schedule. The price quoted was the price charged — no nasty surprises. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Rachel B.

reviews.text: Called them for an EICR on a rental property I'd just bought. Fast turnaround on the report, very competitive price, and they even pointed out a couple of issues I wasn't aware of. Really trustworthy team.
reviews.author: Mohammed A.
